I told Dana in her DM that Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **185 seats**.

The number comes from #north-team, a channel she's in. On 2025-08-20 she posted 180 seats for the amendment, which was signed the day before. A few minutes later she corrected it to "185, not 180."

I couldn't find the amendment file itself in the share, so I suggested she check with June Osei-Lark, who has the signed copy, if she wants to confirm it for the deck. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so it was fine to share and didn't need approval.
